newsitem.title: UK: Granada sells Alpha Airports stake.
newsitem.headline: Granada sells Alpha Airports stake.

text.p: Granada Group Plc said on Tuesday. that it has sold its 25 percent shareholding in Alpha Airports Group Plc for 52.36 million stg in cash.
Granada said that it has sold its shareholding in Alpha Airports to a company owned by Mohamed Al Fayed, the chairman of Harrods department store.
It said the shares were bought by Cylena Establishments, a company owned by Mohamed Al Fayed.
Cylena said that in the absence of a third party offer, it will not make an offer for the remaining shares of Alpha for at least six months.
Granada sold 41.89 million shares at 125p per share ex-dividend and will use the proceeds to reduce borrowings.
